text: (ESA 2022) The plural form of the sentence “the thief is threatening the child with a knife” is:
options: The thiefs are threatening the childs with knives.
The thieves are threatening the childs with knives.
The thieves are threatening the children with knives.
The thiefs are threatening the children with knives.
The thieves is threatening the children with knives.
subject: Inglês
explanation:
(A) The thiefs are threatening the childs with knives.
“thiefs” (erro de plural: correto = thieves)
“childs” (erro de plural: correto = children)

(B) The thieves are threatening the childs with knives.
“thieves” (correto)
“childs” (erro: deveria ser children)

(C) The thieves are threatening the children with knives.
“thieves” plural correto de thief
“are threatning” verbo no plural
“children” plural irregular de child
“knives” plural irregular de knife
Correta!

(D) The thiefs are threatening the children with knives.
“thiefs” (erro: deveria ser thieves)
“children” ️

(E) The thieves is threatening the children with knives.
“thieves”
“is threatening” (erro de concordância: plural → are threatening)
